1) 从告警标签取 cluster，在任一存活节点执行 emqx ctl clu: 1) Take cluster from the alert labels and run emqx ctl cluster status on any surviving node to see which nodes are stopped; 2) Log in to the stopped node and troubleshoot it as a single-node failure (process, memory, disk, logs); 3) If the node cannot be recovered soon, run emqx ctl cluster force-leave <node> to remove it so the routing table stops trying to sync with it; 4) During recovery watch the connection count and memory on the remaining nodes and scale out before letting devices reconnect if needed.
1) 从告警标签取 node，在 Dashboard 的规则引擎页面查看各规则的: 1) Take node from the alert labels and check the per-rule failure counters on the rule engine page of the Dashboard to identify the failing rule and action; 2) Read that action's error in log/emqx.log to distinguish an unreachable downstream, a timeout, and a data format mismatch; 3) For an unreachable downstream, fix it first and confirm the bridge's connection pool and timeout settings are sensible; 4) For format problems, review the field mapping in the rule SQL, verify with the Dashboard's test feature, and then publish.
1) 从告警标签取 node，执行 emqx ctl listeners 查看各: 1) Take node from the alert labels and run emqx ctl listeners to see the current and maximum connections per listener; 2) Run cat /proc/$(pgrep -f beam.smp)/limits | grep 'open files' to confirm the actual fd limit; 3) Raise LimitNOFILE in systemd and node.max_ports in emqx.conf and restart to apply, re-checking memory (each connection costs tens of KB); 4) If misbehaving clients are consuming connections by reconnecting furiously, rate-limit them at the gateway and review the client reconnect backoff.
1) 从告警标签取 node，执行 emqx ctl metrics | gre: 1) Take node from the alert labels and run emqx ctl metrics | grep dropped to separate the drop reasons (queue_full / no_subscribers / expired); 2) queue_full means subscribers are consuming too slowly; investigate the consumers first, then consider raising mqueue_max_len; 3) For no_subscribers, confirm the publisher's topic spelling and whether the subscriber has disconnected; 4) For expired, check that the Message Expiry Interval matches the real delivery latency.
1) 从告警标签取 node，执行 emqx ctl vm memory 查看各: 1) Take node from the alert labels and run emqx ctl vm memory to see the breakdown (processes/binary/ets); 2) A high binary share usually means messages piling up in session queues; look for subscribers that are not consuming fast enough and confirm the hot topics with emqx ctl topics list; 3) A high processes share usually means too many sessions; handle it as for the Erlang process alert; 4) As a stopgap lower mqueue_max_len to cap per-session queue length so a single slow consumer cannot drag the node down.
1) 从告警标签取 node，执行 emqx ctl vm 查看 process: 1) Take node from the alert labels and run emqx ctl vm to see the live process/used and process/limit values; 2) Compare against connection growth to decide whether this is normal growth or a session leak (persistent sessions with clean_session=false accumulating); 3) For accumulating persistent sessions, review the session expiry configuration and spot-check with emqx ctl sessions list; 4) If you genuinely need more capacity, raise node.process_limit in emqx.conf and restart, re-checking memory.
1) 从告警标签取 node，查看 log/emqx.log 中的认证失败记录，: 1) Take node from the alert labels and read the authentication failure entries in log/emqx.log to see the clientid and source IP distribution; 2) Concentrated sources with regular clientids usually mean a broken authentication backend; check that the data source configured in emqx ctl authn list (MySQL/Redis/HTTP) is reachable; 3) Scattered sources with random clientids indicate brute forcing; rate-limit at the firewall or gateway and enable a blacklist; 4) If a batch of credentials expired at once, allow them through temporarily and push the device side to update.
1) 从告警标签取 node，登录该主机执行 emqx ctl status 与: 1) Take node from the alert labels, log in to that host, and run emqx ctl status and systemctl status emqx to check the process; 2) If the process is alive but the status is abnormal, read the tail of log/emqx.log.1; an exhausted Erlang VM heap or a full disk driving the node into self-protection are the usual causes; 3) If the process is gone, rule out resource problems with df -h and free -g before starting it; 4) After recovery run emqx ctl cluster status to confirm the node rejoined the cluster and watch the connection count return.
1) 先确认是否是计划内发布或扩缩容；2) 非计划则查看 log/emqx.lo: 1) First confirm whether this was a planned release or a scaling operation; 2) If unplanned, check log/emqx.log.1 and journalctl -u emqx --since '-30min' for the cause; 3) Run dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process' to rule out an OOM kill, and handle it as a memory alert if that is the case; 4) After the restart watch the connection recovery curve and CPU, and rate-limit reconnections at the gateway if needed so the storm does not take down the node again.
CONNACK 认证失败速率超过 1 次/秒，可能是认证后端故障导致合法设备全部: CONNACK authentication failures exceed 1 per second. Either the authentication backend is broken and legitimate devices cannot connect, or someone is brute-forcing credentials.
EMQX Erlang 进程数逼近上限: EMQX Erlang process count approaching the limit
EMQX 节点内存使用率超过 85%，继续增长会触发过载保护开始拒绝连接，甚至被: EMQX node memory usage exceeds 85%. Continued growth triggers overload protection that refuses connections, and an OOM kill would disconnect every device on the node.
EMQX 节点内存使用率过高: EMQX node memory usage too high
EMQX 节点状态不是 running，该节点已无法接受 MQTT 连接，连在上: The EMQX node's status is not running. It can no longer accept MQTT connections, and every device attached to it will disconnect and reconnect to other nodes.
EMQX 节点运行时间不足 5 分钟，说明刚重启过。非计划重启会导致该节点上的全: The EMQX node has been running for less than 5 minutes, so it restarted recently. An unplanned restart disconnects every device on that node and creates a reconnection storm.
EMQX 规则引擎动作失败率过高: EMQX rule engine action failure rate too high
EMQX 连接数逼近文件描述符上限: EMQX connections approaching the file descriptor limit
EMQX 集群存在已停止的节点: EMQX cluster has a stopped node
Erlang 进程数已占到上限的 80%，EMQX 每个连接与会话都要占用若干: The Erlang process count has reached 80% of its limit. EMQX uses several Erlang processes per connection and session, and once the limit is hit the node refuses new connections outright.
消息丢弃速率超过 1 条/秒，说明消息因队列溢出、无订阅者或超出限制被直接丢掉，: Messages are being dropped at more than 1 per second because of queue overflow, no subscribers, or limit enforcement. The business will experience message loss.
节点当前连接数已占到进程文件描述符上限的 80%，打满后新设备将无法建立连接，表: The node's current connection count has reached 80% of the process file descriptor limit. Once it is exhausted, new devices cannot connect and clients show repeated connection failures.
规则引擎的动作失败率超过 5%，说明数据桥接（写数据库、转发 Kafka、调 H: The rule engine's action failure rate exceeds 5%, meaning data bridges (database writes, Kafka forwarding, HTTP calls) are failing in bulk and downstream systems will be missing data.
集群中有节点处于 stopped 状态，集群整体承载能力下降，剩余节点需要承接掉: A node in the cluster is in the stopped state. Overall cluster capacity is reduced and the remaining nodes must absorb the reconnection storm from the disconnected devices.
